ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What do you call the process that is shown above?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached image shows a cyclic process connected by red arrows. On the leaf at the top there is an egg, on the right is a caterpillar, below is a pupa or chrysalis hanging on a plant, on the left is an adult butterfly, and the arrow goes from the butterfly back to the egg stage. Reasoning: The question asks what the whole process shown in this diagram is called. The diagram shows the repeated developmental stages of a butterfly from egg to larva, to pupa, to adult, and then producing eggs again. In biology, this cyclic process in which an organism develops from one stage to an adult and continues to reproduce is called life cycle.
